findings.actual: Description uses owner/revision-bound registered navigation controller. Existing poiClickGate/poiSelectGate defer outside actions; Finish saves once then replays action, Discard drops draft then replays, Stay returns focus. IME blocks Finish and Apply.
findings.expected: Dirty owner/revision-bound description must route a requested selection/language/navigation action through Finish/Discard/Stay; Finish commits once before navigation, Discard navigates with accepted state unchanged, Stay preserves text/focus. IME or invalid/stale save must not navigate.
findings.evidence: Dedicated browser scenario on9e1 passed Finish/Discard/Stay, IME, RU/EN; final6d5 immutable run repeats it and adds actual before-preparation screenshots.

findings.method: Existing two Node rollback callbacks failed before fix and passed afterward without changing either case.

regression_routing.actual: Dedicated job is now part of every PR/workflow_dispatch; helper runs once in this job, not in the nine legacy runners.
regression_routing.cost: One tiny fixture/browser workflow, approximately one minute CI including build/install. No additional scenario duplication.

limitations: New UI workflow uses a finite authored imported map and supported catalog rows; it is not a full game/corpus or physical-device/accessibility assessment.

Existing Node remap/loss and general E7/E8/DETAIL1 browser suites provide separate regression evidence; every TABLES1 schema2 content + owner-move/water/checkpoint/DETAIL1 UI combination still requires independent T10 review.
